en.headline: Red flags hoisted at four beaches over big waves
en.dek: Leisure and Cultural Services Department warns swimmers away from Stanley Main Beach, Big Wave Bay, Silverstrand and Clear Water Bay Second Beach on Wednesday.
body: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department said red flags were raised on Wednesday at four beaches because of big waves.
The beaches affected are Stanley Main Beach and Big Wave Bay Beach in Southern District on Hong Kong Island, and Silverstrand Beach and Clear Water Bay Second Beach in Sai Kung.
The department advised beachgoers not to swim at these locations while the red flags remain up.
The announcement was issued at 9.30am on Wednesday.

zh.headline: 四個泳灘因大浪懸掛紅旗
zh.dek: 康文署周三表示，赤柱正灘、大浪灣、銀線灣及清水灣第二灘因大浪懸掛紅旗，呼籲泳客勿下水。
body: 康樂及文化事務署表示，周三因大浪在四個泳灘懸掛紅旗。
受影響的泳灘包括港島南區的赤柱正灘及大浪灣泳灘，以及西貢區的銀線灣泳灘及清水灣第二灘。
署方呼籲泳客在紅旗懸掛期間切勿在這些泳灘游泳。
有關公告於周三上午九時三十分發出。
